Santa Cruz County Sheriff's Office has issued an EVACUATION WARNING for CRZ-E070 (Pajaro Dunes) due to high water levels. Residents are encouraged to consider evacuating while roads remain open. Stay away from beaches, avoid flooded roads and monitor official updates. Call 911 for emergencies.

The City of Del Mar: National Weather Service is forecasting conditions that may cause flooding in the Beach Colony neighborhood. Residents and visitors should monitor weather updates, prepare for potential flooding, and avoid driving or walking through flooded areas. Be prepared to evacuate if conditions worsen. More info go to www.delmar.ca.us/964/El-Nino
